name: Synthetic
source:
A game about a person who finds themself at a crossroads in life and doesn't want to decide what to do next.

[From [url=https://katandand.itch.io/synthetic]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个人站在人生的岔路口，不想决定下一步该做什么。这款游戏讲的就是这么个人。

［摘自[url=https://katandand.itch.io/synthetic]itch.io[/url]］
